item.title: It doesn’t matter whether Americans call themselves ‘Zionists’
item.description: A deluge of anti-Zionist propaganda has impacted support for Israel since Oct. 7; still, the majority of Jews stand with it against its antisemitic and genocidal foes. The post It doesn’t matter whether Americans call themselves ‘Zionists’ appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: HUD launches probe into ‘Muslim-only residential development’ in Texas
item.description: “It is deeply concerning that the East Plano Islamic Center may have violated the Fair Housing Act and participated in religious discrimination,” stated HUD Secretary Scott Turner. item.title: International Olympic Committee faces backlash for T-shirt featuring 1936 Berlin Games poster
item.description: Consideration should be given as to “whether any aesthetic appreciation of these games can be comfortably separated from the horror that followed,” Christine Schmidt, co-director of the Wiener Holocaust Library, told “CNN.” The post International Olympic Committee faces backlash for T-shirt featuring 1936 Berlin Games poster appeared first on JNS.org.
